title: Design System: Rally (public landing)
scope: Public signed-out landing page only (src/pages/MarketingHomePage.tsx, src/components/landing/, tokens on .rl). The signed-in app keeps its own system (tailwind.config.js, design-reference/stitch/rally-event-ui/design-system.md) and must not inherit this one.

display.purpose: Hero headline (four lines at 1440) and, at a smaller clamp, the closing headline.

lede.purpose: One or two sentences under a headline, 38-40ch.

card-label.purpose: Uppercase field labels printed on cards, card backs and footer column heads; never a section kicker.

slug.purpose: Caption under a proof print naming the screen.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system has no drop shadows. Depth is overlap, rotation and the painted edge.

shadows.name: drawn-edge
shadows.purpose: Draws the edge of tinted stock (cards, mats) laid on a white sheet. An edge, not elevation.

shadows.name: line-button-ring
shadows.purpose: Outline of the line button on navy; full white on hover, ink on sheets.

shadows.name: painted-edge-card
shadows.purpose: The painted band along the bottom of a business card (background-image).

shadows.name: painted-edge-button
shadows.purpose: The painted band under a primary button; 1px when pressed.

motion.name: ease-deal
motion.purpose: The one easing for every deal, turn and stack change.

motion.name: card-turn
motion.purpose: Person card flips front to back on the Y axis; hero auto-turns once after 2200ms unless touched.

motion.name: deal-in-view
motion.value: translate 1000ms, rotate 1000ms ease-deal; opacity 600ms ease; from 48px down, ~3deg
motion.purpose: Below-the-fold items settle when scrolled into view, staggered by --deal-delay.

motion.name: deal-intro
motion.purpose: Hero hand dealt in on load.

motion.name: stack-print
motion.purpose: Organizer story deals the new proof print over the last.

motion.name: hand-active
motion.purpose: Active card in the dealt hand straightens and lifts 6px.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce there is no deal, intro, turn or stack transition. Timing above is as built and has not been motion-reviewed.

narrative.overview:
The landing page is a hand of business cards dealt on a navy table. The event an organizer runs is the table; every connection Rally records is a card with a back to it, where you met, what was said and what comes next. Real product screens appear as proof prints on card-stock mats, with printer's crop marks and a slug naming the screen they come from. Event photography is mounted like a print, white border and all.

The material is paper on a surface. Depth comes only from objects lapping over one another, from small rotations, and from the painted band along the bottom edge of card stock; nothing floats on a drop shadow. Large white "sheets" of stock are laid over the navy table to carry whole sections, and the hero's proof print rises from under the first sheet. Density is moderate and editorial: big Schibsted Grotesk headlines, short ledes, generous section spacing, and every section built around one object (a hand, a stack of prints, a fan of phones, a ledger).

Motion is dealing. Cards arrive with a short translate and a small rotation that settles on a long exponential ease-out, always from a state that is already visible, and the signature interaction is the card turn: the person card flips front to back, operable by keyboard.
keyCharacteristics: Navy table ground, white and cool-tinted card stock laid over it.
Business cards at true 1.75:1 proportion with a painted blue edge band.
Depth from overlap, rotation and the painted edge; no drop shadows.
Brand blue fills only the primary action of a viewport or the element in focus.
Real screens shown as proof prints with crop marks and a slug caption.
The card turn and the deal as the only motion vocabulary.

rules.name: The One Blue Fill Rule
rules.body: Brand blue fills one thing per viewport: that viewport's primary action, or the active element. The nav's "Create organizer account" is white card stock, not blue, so the hero's blue button owns the first viewport. Small blue ink (edge bands, links, ledger checks) is allowed; a second blue fill is not.

rules.name: The Painted Edge Rule
rules.body: The blue band belongs to card stock (business cards, buttons, the wordmark tile). Sheets, photos and print mats never carry it.

rules.name: The Card Field Rule
rules.body: Uppercase tracked labels live on cards, card backs and the footer only. Never put one above a section headline.

rules.name: The Papercut Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. If an object needs separating, lap it over its neighbor, rotate it, tint its face, or draw its edge with an inset hairline.

rules.name: The Recency Rule
rules.body: In a stack, the newest object is on top and darkest; earlier ones fade (the organizer story's previous print sits at 38% opacity, its steps dim to on-table-3).

dos: Do keep every new landing element inside the .rl root and its tokens.
Do give card stock its painted band (5px on cards, 3px on buttons), drawn as a background gradient so it follows the corner.
Do keep business cards at 1.75:1 and size their type in container units with rem floors.
Do show product proof as real captures on a print mat with crop marks and a slug that names the screen.
Do separate overlapping stock with lap, rotation, a tinted face or an inset 1px line hairline.
Do deal motion from a visible default and remove it under reduced motion.
donts: Don't apply this world to the signed-in application; its screens follow tailwind.config.js and design-reference/stitch/rally-event-ui/design-system.md.
Don't use outer drop shadows on cards, prints, sheets or buttons.
Don't fill more than one element per viewport with brand blue.
Don't put the painted band on sheets, photos or print mats.
Don't set uppercase labels above section headlines; tracked caps belong to card fields.
Don't lay a named person card over a photographed face.
Don't lay repeated items out as a row of equal tiles; deal them as a hand.
openNotes: Motion timing is unreviewed: the finish review returned ship on its scored fixes but saw reduced-motion captures only.
Contract named 3px card corners, a 4px edge and #F5F7FB; the build ships 4px corners, a 5px card band (3px on buttons) and #F3F6FB. Build values are recorded.
